title: 2021年12月四级真题 第1套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 As many office workers adapt to remote work, cities may undergo fundamental change if offices remain under-utilized. Who will benefit if working from home becomes the norm?

P2 Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate when workers shift from office to home work. However, these savings result from passing costs on to workers.

P3 Unless employees are fully compensated, this could become a variant of parasitic( 寄生的) capitalism, whereby corporate profits increasingly rely on extracting value from the public—and now personal—realm, rather than on generating new value.

P4 Though employers are backed by a chorus of remote work advocates, others note the loneliness, reduced productivity and inefficiencies of extended remote work.

P5 If working from home becomes permanent, employees will have to dedicate part of their private space to work. This requires purchasing desks, chairs and office equipment.

P6 It also means having private space dedicated to work: the space must be heated, cleaned, maintained and paid for. That depends on many things, but for purposes of illustration, I have run some estimates for Montreal. The exercise is simple but important, since it brings these costs out of the realm of speculation into the realm of meaningful discussion.

P7 Rough calculations show that the savings made by employers when their staff works from home are of similar value to the compensation workers should receive for setting up offices at home.

P8 What does this mean for offices in cities? One of two things may happen: Employers pass these costs onto employees. This would be a form of expropriation( 侵占), with employees absorbing production costs that have traditionally been paid by the employer. This represents a considerable transfer of value from employees to employers.

P9 When employees are properly compensated, employers' real estate savings will be modest. If savings are modest, then the many advantages of working in offices—such as lively atmosphere, rapidity of communication, team-building and acclimatization( 适应环境) of new employees—will encourage employers to shelve the idea of remote work and, like Yahoo in 2013, encourage employees to work most of the time from corporate office space.

questions.q: What does the author say about working from home?
options: It will become the norm sooner or later.
It requires employees to adapt promptly.
It benefits employers at the expense of employees.
It will force cities to transform their infrastructure.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about working from home? 没有 infer/imply/mainly about，而是问作者就 working from home 这一具体话题说了什么，落点在一处可定位的 判断句，因此按细节题处理。

【拆句】题干 What does the author say about working from home? 主干是 What does the author say，about working from home 是 say 的介词宾语状语，无从句、无否定、无比 较，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate when workers shift from office to home work. However, these savings result from passing costs on to workers. 雇主声称：员工从办公室转向居家办公时，他们能在地产上省下相当一笔。然而，这些节省 其实来自把成本转嫁给员工。

【选项】A) 把假设说成必然 It will become the norm sooner or later. 把 if working from home becomes the norm 的假设条件硬改成确定预测，作者只是在假设语境下讨论后果，并未断言它必将 成为常态。 B) 无中生有 It requires employees to adapt promptly. 中的 require 与 promptly 在文中无任何对 应；首段虽提 office workers adapt to remote work，但并未提出“要求迅速适应”的规 定性命题。 C) ✓ 正确 Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate ↔It benefits employers these savings result from passing costs on to workers ↔at the expense of employees 预判到的“雇主受益、员工承担”两段恰好被 It benefits employers at the expense of employees. 同时覆盖，是定位句两部分的同义合并。 D) 过度推断 It will force cities to transform their infrastructure. 中的 force 与 transform their infrastructure 远超原文 cities may undergo fundamental change 的措辞——文中只 是说城市可能发生根本性变化，并未具体到基建改造，更未说“被迫”。 为什么有些人反对在家办公? A) 它削弱团队精神。 B) 它侵犯员工隐私。 C) 它破坏传统价值观。 D) 它对生产力产生负面影响。

questions.q: Why do some people oppose working from home?
options: It discourages team spirit.
It invades employees' privacy.
It undermines traditional values.
It negatively impacts productivity.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why do some people oppose working from home? 用 why 直接问反对原因，答案是文 中明确列举的事实理由，可在一句话里找到，按细节题处理。 47. Why do some people oppose working from home? A) It discourages team spirit. B) It invades employees' privacy. C) It undermines traditional values. D) It negatively impacts productivity.

【拆句】题干 Why do some people oppose working from home? 是标准 why 引导的疑问句， working from home 是 oppose 的动名词宾语，结构清晰，无陷阱。

【定位】Though employers are backed by a chorus of remote work advocates, others note the loneliness, reduced productivity and inefficiencies of extended remote work. 尽管雇主有一群远程办公拥护者助阵，也有人指出长期远程办公带来的孤独感、生产力下降 和低效问题。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 It discourages team spirit. 与 team-building 有形近，但 team-building 出现在尾段 讲办公室优势的语境里，并非反对方的理由；原文反对方提的是 loneliness 而不是 team spirit。 B) 无中生有 It invades employees' privacy. 中的 invades privacy 在文中无对应；dedicate part of their private space to work 只是说要在私人空间里腾地方，并非侵犯隐私。 C) 偷换概念 It undermines traditional values. 中的 traditional values 在原文完全没出现； traditionally been paid by the employer 里的 traditionally 是说“历来由雇主支付”， 跟“传统价值观”风马牛不相及。 D) ✓ 正确 reduced productivity ↔negatively impacts productivity 并列三项里 reduced productivity 与 negatively impacts productivity productivity 一词原词复现，且 reduced 与 negatively impacts 极性一致，是最干净的同义替换。 作者为什么对Montreal进行估算? A) 为严肃讨论提供有说服力的数据。 B) 说明工作模式正在发生的变化。 C) 展示远程办公对生产力的影响。 D) 举例说明远程办公如何影响经济。

questions.q: Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal?
options: To provide convincing data for serious discussion.
To illustrate the ongoing change in working patterns.
To show the impact of remote working on productivity.
To exemplify how remote working affects the economy.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal? 问的是作者具体动作的目的，原文 一般在动作句的同一句或紧邻句用 since/so as to/in order to 直接给出，按细节题处理。

【拆句】题干 Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal? 是 why 引导的一般疑问句过 去时，for Montreal 作 estimates 的修饰短语，结构简单，无陷阱。 48. Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal? A) To provide convincing data for serious discussion. B) To illustrate the ongoing change in working patterns. C) To show the impact of remote working on productivity. D) To exemplify how remote working affects the economy.

【定位】The exercise is simple but important, since it brings these costs out of the realm of speculation into the realm of meaningful discussion. 这项估算操作虽简单却重要，因为它把这些成本从空想范畴推进到可作有意义讨论的范畴。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 brings these costs out of the realm of speculation ↔convincing data into the realm of meaningful discussion ↔serious discussion 选项 To provide convincing data for serious discussion. 把 since 子句的两段（出空 想→入严肃讨论）逐一对应，是最干净的同义替换。 B) 答非所问 To illustrate the ongoing change in working patterns. 中的 change in working patterns 在原文是话题背景，不是作者做估算的目的；since 子句里完全没有这一 含义。 C) 张冠李戴 To show the impact of remote working on productivity. 把 reduced productivity 的子话题硬装成估算目的；蒙特利尔估算估的是成本，不是生产力。 D) 过度推断 To exemplify how remote working affects the economy. 把作者只为蒙特利尔一城做 的成本估算拔高为“对经济的影响”，原文 since 子句只说要推进 meaningful discussion，没有提 the economy。 我们能从作者的计算中得出什么结论? A) 将办公室工作转为在家办公毫无意义。 B) 员工从远程办公中获得的好处与雇主一样多。 C) 雇主从远程办公中获得的收益应作为补偿给予员工。 D) 应采取有效措施激励员工在家设立办公场所。

questions.q: What can we conclude from the author's calculations?
options: There is no point in transferring office work to working from home.
Employees can benefit as much from remote working as their employers.
Employers' gain from remote working should go to employees as compensation.
Effective measures should be taken to motivate employees to set up offices at home.
questions.explain:
【判型】What can we conclude from the author's calculations? 用 conclude，要求由文内信息 推出一个未直接写出的结论，但只能一步延伸，属于轻推断题。

【拆句】题干 What can we conclude from the author's calculations? 是 wh-疑问句，from the author's calculations 是 conclude 的来源状语，结构简单，无陷阱。 49. What can we conclude from the author's calculations? A) There is no point in transferring office work to working from home. B) Employees can benefit as much from remote working as their employers. C) Employers' gain from remote working should go to employees as compensation. D) Effective measures should be taken to motivate employees to set up offices at home.

【定位】Rough calculations show that the savings made by employers when their staff works from home are of similar value to the compensation workers should receive for setting up offices at home. 粗略计算表明，员工居家办公时雇主所节省的费用，与员工为在家设立办公空间应得的补偿 金额相当。

【选项】A) 过度推断 There is no point in transferring office work to working from home. 用 no point in 全盘否定居家办公，原文只说省额会被补偿抵消，并未说居家办公毫无意义；这是把 作者的有限主张推过头。 B) 偷换概念 Employees can benefit as much from remote working as their employers. 中的 as much as 等同关系在原文无对应；原文是说雇主省的需要全数补偿员工，并未推出员工 获得等额收益。 C) ✓ 正确 the savings made by employers ↔Employers' gain from remote working are of similar value to the compensation workers should receive ↔ should go to employees as compensation 预判到的“雇主省的≈员工该被补的→所以这笔钱应转给员工”恰好被 Employers' gain from remote working should go to employees as compensation. 完整覆盖，是教 科书式的一步推断。 D) 与原文相反 Effective measures should be taken to motivate employees to set up offices at home. 中的 motivate 是规定性命题，原文从未提出任何鼓励员工建家庭办公室的政策 建议；恰恰相反，作者偏向回办公室。 作者对在家办公的看法是什么? A) 如果可能应该避免。 B) 它只是一种临时措施。 C) 它可以降低公司的房地产成本。 D) 它可能影响员工的企业忠诚度。

questions.q: What is the author's opinion on working from home?
options: It should be avoided if possible.
It is only a temporary measure.
It can reduce companies' real estate costs.
It may affect employees' corporate loyalty.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the author's opinion on working from home? 直接用 opinion 询问作者态度， 需要聚合全文极性词，按态度题特殊路径处理。 50. What is the author's opinion on working from home? A) It should be avoided if possible. B) It is only a temporary measure. C) It can reduce companies' real estate costs. D) It may affect employees' corporate loyalty.

【拆句】题干 What is the author's opinion on working from home? 主干是 What is the author's opinion，on working from home 修饰 opinion，限定话题范围，结构简单，无 陷阱。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 shelve the idea of remote work ↔It should be avoided if possible. parasitic(寄生的) capitalism ↔should be avoided 全文从 parasitic→expropriation→shelve 一路负向收束，无一处肯定，It should be avoided if possible. 是唯一与主线全篇极性一致的选项。 B) 无中生有 It is only a temporary measure. 中的 temporary 在原文没有任何对应词；作者讨论的 是若成为常态会怎样，并未把它定性为“临时措施”。 C) 张冠李戴 It can reduce companies' real estate costs. 是雇主的说法 Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate，但作者随即反驳并在尾段说 employers' real estate savings will be modest——所以这不是作者的观点。 D) 无中生有 It may affect employees' corporate loyalty. 中的 corporate loyalty 在文中完全没出 现，作者关心的是成本转嫁与办公室优势，不涉及忠诚度问题。
